opportunities.name: Kayak hotel (Stays) search with dates and guests
opportunities.description: On Kayak Stays, enter a destination, pick check-in/check-out dates in the calendar, set rooms/adults/children (and child age), then search and optionally sort/filter results.
steps: Open Kayak and click Stays in the left nav
Click the destination field and type the destination
Select the matching suggestion from the dropdown
Open the date picker and click check-in and check-out dates
Open the guests dropdown and set rooms, adults, children (and child age)
Click the search button
Optionally sort results (price low to high) or apply filters (hotel class, review score, style, amenities)
parameters: filters (star class, review score, amenities, style)

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; Mar 27-Apr 2; 2 rooms, 3 guests; sort price low to high
Santa Fe, NM; Jun 16-18; 2 rooms, 3 guests
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; Jun 6-10; 2 rooms, 4 guests, child age 7; filters 8+ score, 3-star, family style, air-conditioned
Los Angeles; May 21-23; 1 room, 2 guests; 4-star filter

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search with dates, guests and filters
opportunities.description: On Booking.com (via Qatar partner page), search a destination with dates, set adults/rooms, then filter results and open a hotel.
steps: Open the Booking.com hotel search page
Type the destination and select the suggestion
Open the calendar and choose check-in and check-out dates
Set adults, children and rooms, click Done
Click Search
Apply filters (neighbourhood, 5 stars, free WiFi)
Open a hotel and click See availability

instances.values: Las Vegas; Apr 10-16; 2 adults 1 room; sort price lowest first
Washington DC; Jun 5-6; 4 adults 2 rooms; Downtown DC, 5 stars, free WiFi filters

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search with route, date and passengers
opportunities.description: On Qatar Airways, enter origin and destination airports, select a departure date, set passenger counts and cabin class, then show flights and select a fare.
steps: Open the Book tab on Qatar Airways
Enter From airport and choose from dropdown
Enter To airport and choose from dropdown
Set trip type (one way/return)
Open date picker and select departure date
Open passengers dropdown, set adults/children/infants and class, click Confirm
Click Show flights
Select the fare on the results

instances.values: Colombo to New York JFK, one way, 24 Jun, 3 passengers, Premium class; Stopover tab
Doha to Durban, one way, 28 May, 3 passengers, Economy
